_doc: Size + comment ratchet. New files must stay under maxNewFileLines. Listed files must not grow. Comment share per directory must not rise. Lower these numbers as the refactor lands; never raise one without a note in 'exceptions'.

filesNotes.browser-extension/src/content/pageApiMai: MAIN-world classic content script: no import, and a module graph would need web_accessible_resources widened (Phase 1 narrowed it to one file) or a shared global on the PAGE's window. Not splittable without giving up one of the two.
Classic content script (manifest content_scripts + executeScript into open tabs): one world-shared scope, no import. A split needs an isolated-world global AND ordered injection, which registrars.js's fire-and-forget loop does not guarantee.
filesNotes.browser-extension/src/lib/drop/overlay.j: One function handed to executeScript({ func }) — Chrome serialises the function and nothing else, so it must stay self-contained (tests/injectedFuncs.test.js pins that).
filesNotes.browser-extension/src/lib/control/custom: One closure, and every test on it reads its SOURCE — pins before motion: it needs a behavioural DOM harness before it can be split.

_notes.commentPct: commentPct was re-measured when the walker began counting .d.ts files: a shape file is mostly declarations with a documenting line above each, so every directory holding one reads a few points higher. No prose was added — the measured scope grew. These are the new floors.
